fact: Burundi, landlocked with no cable landing, relies on Tanzania, which has the 2Africa, EASSy and SEACOM cables; TTCL and BBS signed a new five-year capacity agreement worth 3.3 million dollars after the October 2019 one.
title: La Tanzanie signe un nouvel accord de cinq ans avec le Burundi pour lui fournir des capacités télécoms à haut débit
